primary_sources.title: Java Language Specification SE 25, 6.6 Access Control
claims: Java access control exists to prevent users of a package or class from depending on unnecessary implementation details
public/protected/package/private accessibility is a compile-time property governed by declaration and context

primary_sources.title: Java Language Specification SE 25, 8.1.4 Superclasses and Subclasses
claims: Object has no direct superclass and a normal class without an extends clause has Object as its direct superclass
a normal class declaration has one direct superclass type when extends is present

primary_sources.title: Java Language Specification SE 25, 8.4.8 Inheritance, Overriding, and Hiding
claims: classes inherit eligible methods from direct superclasses subject to accessibility and signature rules
instance methods participate in overriding while class/static methods participate in hiding
overriding has return-type and access-related compile-time requirements

primary_sources.title: Java Language Specification SE 25, 8.4.9 Overloading and 15.12 Method Invocation Expressions
claims: same-name methods whose signatures are not override-equivalent are overloaded
method invocation performs compile-time applicability and most-specific selection before run-time invocation

primary_sources.title: Java Language Specification SE 25, 15.12.4.4 Locate Method to Invoke
claims: static invocation needs no target reference and overriding is not allowed
for virtual/interface instance invocation, overriding may occur and dynamic lookup begins from the actual run-time class of the target object
private methods are invoked directly rather than selected through ordinary overriding lookup

primary_sources.title: Java Language Specification SE 25, Chapter 9 Interfaces
claims: a class can directly implement one or more interfaces and interface types provide common supertypes without a common abstract superclass
interface methods may be public/private, abstract/default/static; therefore modern interfaces are not limited to abstract method declarations
